text:
Maya R.: Thanks for the all-hands — quick thread to collect follow-ups on pipeline / partners: a few bullets from the Q&A. 1) Where are we prioritizing BD vs. product-led for next quarter? 2) Can we get clarity on the top 3 partners we're committing resources to? 3) Any changes to demo SKU / trial packaging? cc: @Alison C., @Samir K.

Alison C.: Great capture. Short answers: 1) Hybrid approach — PLG remains the primary acquisition funnel, but we're allocating 2 SDRs to targeted mid-market outbound for high-value accounts. 2) Top partners: CloudForge, DataVault, EdgeAI — pilots committed this quarter. 3) Demo SKU will be simplified (no infra prereq) — rollout mid-April. Will share follow-up doc. :white_check_mark:

Samir K.: Adding detail: partnership pilots will include co-marketing and lead credits. Partners will be expected to contribute scoped integration time in exchange for prioritized leads. I’ll share the partner playbook link and contact matrix later today.

Jia (Product): Demo SKU note — proposed change is to remove the dedicated GPU requirement for the public demo. Need ops confirmation on cost and perf tradeoffs. This also means update to the onboarding flow and PRD.

Kevin L. (Eng): Ops take: removing dedicated GPU for demo means using smaller vCPU-backed instances + light quantized models for initial demo paths. Cost estimate roughly +$0.12 per demo session, which is sustainable at current demo volume. I’ll add the infra patch and cost table to the PRD.

Maya R.: Awesome — can we convert this into an action list with owners and dates? Want to hand to Sales Ops and Partnerships.

Alison C.: Yes. Action list (high level):
- Samir K.: publish partner playbook + contact list (due 2026-04-04)
- Jia (Product): updated PRD for demo SKU (due 2026-03-31)
- Kevin L. (Eng): infra cost breakdown + deploy changes (due 2026-04-02)
- Maya R.: compile pipeline asks + distribution to Sales Ops (due 2026-04-01)
I’ll drop a short follow-up doc in the all-hands drive and tag relevant owners. :ballot_box_with_check:

Samir K.: noted. happy to intro folks at CloudForge and DataVault if helpful — ping me directly.

Alison C.: Quick FYI on goals tied to this: target is +25% QoQ growth in paid-seat conversions driven by PLG improvements; Dedicated sales focus is to progress 3 mid-market pilots to POC by EOY Q2.

Maya R.: Thanks everyone. I’ll synthesize into a one-pager and post here by tomorrow. :rocket:
